# name=flags, one a line; the first is the base the others are held to.
base=
tid=-DPEARL_AMD_TID=1
pfxl=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_TID=1 -DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=1
pin=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1
pinnolp=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=0
gopq=-DPEARL_AMD_GOPQ=1
pinc=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1
pinb=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_BUFLD=1
u4=-DPEARL_AMD_PFX=1 -DPEARL_AMD_TID=1 -DPEARL_AMD_LPIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_CRANK=1 -DPEARL_AMD_SCHEDB=1 -DPEARL_AMD_UNROLL4=1
tidst=-DPEARL_AMD_TID=1 -DPEARL_AMD_STAMP=1
pinst=-DPEARL_AMD_PF2PIN=1 -DPEARL_AMD_STAMP=1
